description: This is a modern, minimalist stool with a light wood frame and a cane-woven seat and sides. The frame has rounded edges and a U-shaped structure that forms the legs and supports. The top surface and the two open sides are filled with intricate cane weaving, creating a textured and airy appearance. The wood has a natural, warm tone with visible grain patterns, complementing the neutral color of the cane. Its compact and clean design makes it a versatile piece for various interior settings, offering both functional seating and a touch of natural, bohemian-inspired style.
